purpose: Topological-sector response to a local pair interaction after removing its entire occupation-count conditional mean
analysis_status: retrospective new-observable reanalysis of existing Phase-E samples, not a preregistered new trial

definitions.T_nn: sum eta_i eta_j over the 2N simple undirected Euclidean nearest-neighbour edges
definitions.R: (T_nn - 2K(K-1)/(N-1))/(2N): fixed-K residual, not a strictly local canonical potential
definitions.H: Q-R: a function of K only
definitions.matching_parity: fixed Euclidean stencil under (G_black,G_white,eta,p)->(G_white,G_black,1-eta,1-p); not a claim that the current-black-graph NN edge set stays unchanged
definitions.physical_measure: P_lambda(eta) proportional to P_p(eta) exp(lambda Q(eta)); conditional on K, its tangent equals that of R

primary_question: Is the finite directional E_top interaction response carried by occupation-count changes H or the fixed-K geometry R?
estimation: paired pooled sample covariances; delete the same one of 100 batches in both orientations, recompute all nonlinear statistics; save full covariance and leave-one-out vectors
cost_scope: deterministic replay of exactly 40000 old configurations with two paired geometries each; no additional random samples or servers
limitations: no new independent evidence beyond the source stream
fixed-K orthogonality does not imply zero continuum thermal overlap
no continuum energy-field identification or permission gate
